claim_limit: C2.2 placement contract and one real substitution link; no product, hardware, latency or release claim before that link and its later smoke gates pass.

format_boundary.general_multibank_store: not introduced; recorded C3-class growth path

transition.prepare_operation: c2_product_prepare_boot invalidates all C2 reachability and generation before selecting boot-validation
transition.switch_cutpoint: after successful phase 3 and before any phase 4 call
switch_preconditions: transport idle and execution window wiped
no product directory or export has been published
transition.postcondition: session-runtime is the only executable family for the generation
transition.reverse_transition: forbidden; restage begins with the generation-invalidating prepare operation

required_negative_cases: boot re-entry while generation remains live
wrong family catalog or physical base
simultaneously executable boot and session families
link_rule: After the addendum receipt, run exactly one complete product substitution link with every capacity dimension and the one-truth closure; stop on its first red.
